battleFormations.name: Grizzled Company
battleFormations.effect: Ruthless Discipline: Each OFFICER can issue 1 additional Order per Command phase; ordered units can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

battleFormations.name: Siege Regiment
battleFormations.effect: Artillery Support: At the start of the battle round, select one: Creeping Barrage (mortal wounds to far enemy units on 5+ and shaken effect), Incendiary Bombardment (remove Benefit of Cover from selected units), or Smoke Shells (grant Stealth to selected units). Number of units affected scales with battle size.

battleFormations.name: Hammer of the Emperor
battleFormations.effect: Iron Tread: SQUADRON units Advance without a roll, adding 6" to Move; can move within (but not end within) Engagement Range of enemy units.

battleFormations.name: Mechanised Assault
battleFormations.effect: Armoured Fist: Add 1 to the Wound roll for ranged attacks made by models that disembarked from a Transport this turn.

battleFormations.name: Recon Element
battleFormations.effect: Masters of Camouflage: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units (excluding TITANIC) have the Stealth ability.

battleFormations.name: Combined Arms
battleFormations.effect: Born Soldiers: REGIMENT ranged attacks vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE units gain [LETHAL HITS]; SQUADRON ranged attacks vs MONSTER/VEHICLE units gain [LETHAL HITS].

artefacts.name: Death Mask of Ollanius
artefacts.effect: [OFFICER only] If the bearer's unit is Battle-shocked, reduce its Objective Control by 1 instead of to 0.

artefacts.name: Drill Commander
artefacts.effect: [OFFICER only] While the bearer's unit remains stationary, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

artefacts.name: Grand Strategist
artefacts.effect: [OFFICER only] The bearer can issue 1 additional Order per Command phase.

artefacts.name: Reactive Command
artefacts.effect: [OFFICER only] If an enemy unit sets up within 8" of the bearer, it can issue 1 extra Order (does not count toward normal limit).

artefacts.name: Eager Advance
artefacts.effect: [INFANTRY OFFICER only] A REGIMENT unit led by the bearer gains the Scouts 6" ability.

artefacts.name: Flash Grenades
artefacts.effect: [INFANTRY OFFICER only] The bearer's unit is immune to Fire Overwatch.

artefacts.name: Legacy Sidearm
artefacts.effect: [INFANTRY OFFICER only] Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of Pistols equipped by the bearer.

artefacts.name: Stalwart's Honours
artefacts.effect: [OFFICER only] A unit that receives an Order from the bearer also automatically gains the Take Cover! Order's effect.

artefacts.name: Bold Leadership
artefacts.effect: [INFANTRY OFFICER only] The bearer's unit retains control of a contested objective marker under specified conditions.

artefacts.name: Sacred Unguents
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER only] Re-roll Hit rolls for a nearby friendly Transport.

artefacts.name: Smoke Grenades
artefacts.effect: [INFANTRY OFFICER only] Grants Benefit of Cover and Stealth to units near friendly Transports.

artefacts.name: Vanguard Honours
artefacts.effect: [INFANTRY OFFICER only] The bearer's unit can disembark from a Transport even after that Transport has Advanced (shock disembark).

artefacts.name: Calm Under Fire
artefacts.effect: [VEHICLE OFFICER only] The bearer can issue the same Order to a second Squadron.

artefacts.name: Indomitable Steed
artefacts.effect: [VEHICLE OFFICER only] The bearer has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

artefacts.name: Regimental Banner
artefacts.effect: [VEHICLE OFFICER only] Add 3 to the bearer's Objective Control characteristic.

artefacts.name: Veteran Crew
artefacts.effect: [VEHICLE OFFICER only] Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for the bearer.

artefacts.name: Guerrilla Honours
artefacts.effect: [INFANTRY OFFICER only] After deployment, redeploy up to 3 units, any of which can instead be placed into Strategic Reserves.

artefacts.name: Scare Gas Grenades
artefacts.effect: [INFANTRY only] Once per battle, force a nearby enemy unit to take a Battle-shock test.

artefacts.name: Survival Gear
artefacts.effect: [INFANTRY only] The bearer's unit gains the Scouts 6" ability.

artefacts.name: Tripwires
artefacts.effect: [INFANTRY only] If an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of the bearer's unit, on a 4+ that enemy unit suffers -1 to Hit rolls.

artefacts.name: Abhuman Detail
artefacts.effect: [COMMISSAR only] The bearer can issue Orders to units with the OGRYN keyword, and can attach to OGRYN SQUAD/BULLGRYN SQUAD units.

armyRules.name: Voice of Command (Orders)
armyRules.effect: OFFICER models can issue an Order to a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit within 6" in your Command phase (and on disembark/setup). Orders: Move! Move! Move! (+3" Move), Fix Bayonets! (+1 WS melee), Take Aim! (+1 BS ranged), First Rank Fire! Second Rank Fire! (+1 Attacks to Rapid Fire weapons), Take Cover! (+1 Save, max 3+), Duty and Honour! (+1 Leadership, +1 OC). One Order per unit at a time; cannot target Battle-shocked units.

sourceNotes: Detachment rules/Enhancements verified against Wahapedia wh40k11ed where marked; entries carried over from prior data are unverified placeholders pending confirmation.
